subtitle: Original English diagrams, formulas, labels and code unchanged.

questions.stem: Knowledge Distillation అంటే ఏమిటి? Large Teacher నుంచి Small Student Model ఎలా Learn చేస్తుంది?
options: Teacher Full Network, Weights Studentకి Exactly Copy చేస్తాం.
Small Student Teacher Predictions నుంచి Useful Behavior Learn చేస్తుంది.
Teacher Only Student Examplesతో Retrain చేసి Student Weights Ignore చేస్తుంది.
Teacher Extra Labels Gather చేసి Student Independentగా Trains చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Big Teacher Predictionsని Small Student Learn చేస్తుంది. All Weights Copy చేయదు.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. Teacher Usually Fixed; Student Soft Predictions, Hidden Features నుంచి Own Weights Train చేస్తుంది.

questions.stem: Edge Devicesకి Knowledge Distillation ఎందుకు Useful? Small Student Memory, Compute ఎలా Save చేస్తుంది?
options: Large Teacher Remote Storageలో ఉంటే Phone Offline Fully Runs అంటుంది.
Every Layer Wider చేసి Less Training Data Use చేస్తాం.
Difficult Classes Remove చేసి Architecture Unchangedగా Keep చేస్తాం.
Useful Teacher Skills Smaller Studentకి Transfer చేసి Resources Save చేస్తాం.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Small Student Less RAM, Compute Use చేయవచ్చు. Useful Accuracy Preserve చేయాలి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. Compact Model Storage, Memory, Latency Reduce చేయవచ్చు. Actual Quality, Hardware Speedపై Test చేయాలి.
